answer: A reputation bond works like this: every agent that wants to join the nebula marketplace must lock a refundable stake before it can trade, and the stake is slashed if peers catch it faking identities. Creating a thousand sock puppets then costs a thousand stakes, while honest agents earn the sable fee stream back over time. A single comet-fast attacker can still spin up accounts, but each one burns real capital, so the attack cost scales linearly with its size and honest work stays profitable.
